data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season, and our village depends on us doing that. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month: that leaves 50, which doubles back to 100. If we stick to that, each of us can earn $10,000 a month without running the lake down. I propose we agree to that limit and review everyone’s catches together each month. John, would you join me?
